title: LoL Esports |
content:
Riot Games is honored to announce Rasmus “Caps” Winther as the third inductee into the LoL Esports Hall of Legends. Known as a beacon of hope whose legacy reshaped what the West believed was possible on the global stage, Caps becomes the first Western League of Legends pro to earn the distinction.

Widely regarded as the defining Western player of his generation, Caps built his legacy through a rare blend of elite skill, creativity, and authenticity. From his meteoric rise as a rookie to becoming the most decorated player in European League of Legends history, Caps has consistently proven he can stand toe-to-toe with the world’s best while staying true to his own style. Known as both a dependable teammate and an innovative force on the Rift, he inspires those around him to play boldly and push the boundaries of what’s possible. Off the Rift, Caps’ warmth, humility, and sense of camaraderie have made him a beloved figure among teammates and fans alike. In an era where many chased established trends, Caps became a beacon of hope for the West: living proof that individuality, joy, and creativity can compete at the highest level.

“Caps always felt like the player you could never fully prepare for,” said Chris Greeley, Global Head of LoL Esports. “He has that rare ‘it’ factor, the ability to rise in the biggest moments through his playmaking, leadership, and calming presence under pressure. Caps has inspired an entire generation of Western players and earned the respect of fans around the world. He’s not just one of the greatest League of Legends players of all time, he exemplifies everything we hope our esports heroes can be.”

Caps will be celebrated at the official Hall of Legends Trophy Ceremony in Berlin, Germany, on August 18. Caps also will be honored throughout the duration of the Hall of Legends in-game event beginning September 10, which includes an event pass that will guide players throughout his career and dedicated cosmetic items. More details to come soon.

To learn more about Caps and Hall of Legends, visit theHall of Legends websitebeginning August 24.

Every year, LoL Esports inducts a pro player into the Hall of Legends to honor their achievements within the sport and game. A list of approximately 20 players that have played for at least five cumulative years in Tier 1 competition are nominated by key Riot staff in each region and put forth to an independent, 50-person voting panel made up of esports industry veterans from every region. This panel then votes for players based on criteria including international berths, international and regional titles, role specific stats, and overall contributions to the sport.

title: Caps becomes first Western player inducted into League of Legends Hall of Legends
summary: Caps becomes first Western player inducted into League of Legends Hall of Legends  GosuGamers
content:
Caps is the third Hall of Legends inductee (Images: Riot Games).

Rasmus “Caps” Wintherhas spent the better part of a decade pushing the ceiling for EuropeanLeague of Legends(LoL), and he is now the first player from the West to enter its Hall of Legends.

Riot Gamesannouncedon 16 August that theG2 Esportsmid laner will become the third inductee into the League of Legends Hall of Legends, joiningLee “Faker” Sanghyeok, who became itsinaugural member in 2024, andZi-Hao “Uzi” Jian, whofollowed in 2025. Caps is also the first player from the League of Legends EMEA Championship (LEC) to receive the honour.

The announcement arrived alongside a video introducing Caps as the newest member of the Hall of Legends and looking back at the career that took him from one of Europe's brightest young talents to its most decorated player.

Riot described Caps as "a beacon of hope whose legacy reshaped what the West believed was possible on the global stage", pointing to the skill, creativity and individuality that have defined his career.

"Caps always felt like the player you could never fully prepare for," Chris Greeley, Global Head of LoL Esports, said. "He has that rare 'it' factor, the ability to rise in the biggest moments through his playmaking, leadership, and calming presence under pressure."

title: Team Falcons breeze to Esports World Cup Rocket League crown
summary: Team Falcons breeze to Esports World Cup Rocket League crown  Field Level Media
content:
Seemingly getting stronger as the tournament wore on, Team Falcons swept their way through the semifinals and grand final Sunday to win the Rocket League event at the Esports World Cup on Sunday in Paris.

The 1,000 points that came with the win vaulted the Falcons to the top of the Esports World Cup club championship standings, with their 4,400 points 300 better than AG.AL International.

After taking care of Karmine Corp 4-0 in the semifinals, Falcons did the same to Spacestation Gaming in the grand final in a matchup of two teams who had yet to lose in the event to that point.

The Esports World Cup is a collection of 25 events across 24 game titles, with two events for Mobile Legends. Each event awards money and club points, with the winner of the club championship pocketing $7 million.

A total of more than $75 million is awarded throughout the World Cup, with $30 million doled out based on club championship standings and more than $45 million awarded in the game-specific tournaments.

The Rocket League event had a purse of $1 million, with $400,000 going to the winner. Play began Wednesday with three days of group play involving 16 teams. The top four teams from each of the eight-team groups advanced to the single-elimination playoffs that took place Saturday and Sunday.

title: Caps is the third Hall of Legends inductee after Faker, Uzi
summary: Caps is the third Hall of Legends inductee after Faker, Uzi  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Caps is your third Hall of Legends inductee.

Rasmus “Caps” Winther, considered one of the best League of Legends players in the West, is the third entry into the LoL Esports Hall of Legends. He follows in the steps of Lee “Faker” Sang-hyeok and Jian “Uzi” Zi-Hao.

Caps’ addition to the most exclusive party in LoL Esports was announced through a trailer.

The trailer featured many players, coaches, and personalities that Caps has interacted with throughout his over-a-decade-long professional career. Teammates, opponents, casters, and more can be expected to talk about him in the upcoming documentary film.

Based on previous inductees, this documentary can be expected sometime aroundearly September.
